name: pixel-game-art-director
local_image_count_scope: Tutorial-library image files only; excludes demo artwork, font files and runtime screenshots.

runtime_dependencies.theme_contract_validation: Python 3.9+ standard library; validates recorded structure and evidence, not visual quality
runtime_dependencies.rural_shop_demo: Browser with ES modules; serve HTML, CSS, JavaScript and local assets over HTTP

license_notes: Bundled tutorials retain per-source licenses in library/LICENSES.md. Fusion Pixel and upstream font notices remain SIL OFL 1.1. Five AI demo images are offered under MIT only to the extent rights are held, with no guarantee of exclusivity or independent copyright. Commercial game reference images are remote links, not bundled open assets. Editorial profiles are suggestions, not author style categories.
machine_audit_boundary: Configured technical checks only; visual review remains required.
ui_case_image_policy: Official screenshot, developer mockup and official guide links with original analysis; commercial image binaries are not bundled.
ui_framework_boundary: Editorial working framework grounded in scoped sources; not an exhaustive academic taxonomy or user-tested UI kit.
visual_case_image_policy: Official Steam screenshots reviewed individually; observations and design inferences separated; commercial image binaries are not bundled. Counted separately from the existing 14 UI cases and 28 image references.

rural_shop_demo.shared_content: Chinese products, purchase quantities, balance, stock and bag state
rural_shop_demo.runtime_scope: Operable shop-interface comparison prototype over local HTTP; not a complete roamable game.
rural_shop_demo.revision_scope: Visual rework after explicit user rejection of v1.3.0: restrained paper border, reading hierarchy, transaction-led ledger and bottom world trade window. Functional test counts do not establish visual acceptance.
rural_shop_demo.typography_scope: Fusion Pixel identity headings; system Chinese for most product and transaction text; 14px Songti fallback ledger note. Comparison-tool text may be 10-12px. This records primary roles, not proof of every rendered control or visual acceptance.

world_variant.label_policy: Chinese short names in product cells; full names retained in details and accessible labels

rural_shop_demo.ledger_variant: Right page presents current-purchase accounting; planting tutorial fields hidden, underlying product and transaction data retained.
rural_shop_demo.production_boundary: Hard-alpha gate failed for item-atlas.png; a unified logical pixel grid remains undetermined. These are pixel-style prototype assets, not certified production pixel sprites.

theme_contract_policy: All assets inherit one project theme; per-asset independent style selection is prohibited. Role-level exceptions require rationale, bounded scope and recorded review evidence; exceptions do not waive production gates.
theme_contract_validator_boundary: Checks structure, inheritance, file bindings and recorded evidence only. Structure PASS is not an automated visual-cohesion judgment.
